title: Broadcast Locally
symptom: User activated Broadcast locally in xDrip but their app does not receive any broadcast, while a System Broadcast works.
cause: The user's intent filter was configured only with the name of the xDrip package, missing the correct broadcast action name.
fix: Add the correct intent filter name found in the xDrip source code to the app's intent filter to receive the broadcast.
evidence_quote: To receive the broadcast from xDrip, I have add a filter but only with the name of the xDrip package. In the source code I find the correcte name to configure correctely my intent filter.
